title: Add size-based UV scaling for CSG nodes
body: - Supersedes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117202 - Supersedes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119696 - Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14133 This PR adds an option to scale the UVs generated by `CSGPrimitive3D` nodes to match their size, avoiding the need to use triplanar UVs. I used the fixes for `CSGCylinder3D` and `CSGTorus3D` UVs from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117202 by @Jesusemora, branching from their PR. ~~Unlike my [previous PR](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119696) I decided not to include `uv_offset` and `uv_scale` in this one. Mainly because each type would require a custom way of changing such options (`CSGCylinder3D` for example would have 4 `Vector2`s, for controlling offset and scale for the side faces and the cap faces separately), but also because controlling UVs per face together with a per face material override would be better in a future PR.~~ - Implemented simple `uv_scale` and `uv_offset` as `Vector2`s that are applied equally to all faces. - Added `uv_match_size` property to `CSGPrimitive3D` for toggling UV scaling - `CSGMesh3D` is not affected by `uv_match_size` | Before | After | | --- | --- | ||| | Type | Demo | | --- | --- | | `CSGBox3D` || | `CSGSphere3D`, `CSGCylinder3D` || | `CSGTorus3D` || | `CSGPolygon3D` (path) || | `CSGPolygon3D` (spin) || | `CSGPolygon3D` (depth) ||

files.patch:
@@ -14,5 +14,8 @@
 		<member name="flip_faces" type="bool" setter="set_flip_faces" getter="get_flip_faces" default="false">
 			If set, the order of the vertices in each triangle are reversed resulting in the backside of the mesh being drawn.
 		</member>
+		<member name="uv_match_size" type="bool" setter="set_uv_match_size" getter="get_uv_match_size" default="false">
+			If set, will scale UVs to match face dimensions, making materials repeat instead of stretch. Has no effect on [CSGMesh3D].
+		</member>
 	</members>
 </class>
